events.comment: idle -> stunned (when animation works)
Posture broken: drop the attack, deflect, roll or hit reaction, along with any saved press, and go to the idle pose. Also adds a strong hit-stop and screen shake.
Stamina and Attacking Rules
Scene start: create the attack recovery and deflect timers, because a timer that does not exist yet can never pass its check.
Attack input: AttackPressed is true for one frame per press.
Deflect input: DeflectPressed is true for one frame per press. Clear it first.
Deflect input: the K key.
Deflect input: right mouse button. Once keeps a held button to a single press.
Roll input: RollPressed is true for one frame per press.
Input buffer: closed unless one of the events below opens it.
Input buffer: open once an attack, lunge, roll, deflect or hit reaction has played BufferStart of its animation. An earlier press is ignored, so it does not commit the player to anything.
Input buffer: also open during the AttackRecovery pause, so a press there plays as soon as the pause ends.
Input buffer: a grab or posture break closes it and drops anything saved. AllowCombo is cleared by those events already.
Input buffer: locked controls drop a saved attack or roll. A deflect can still be saved, because the ultimate locks the player and every slash has to be deflected.
Input buffer: save an attack. Only one action is saved, so the latest press replaces the others.
Input buffer: save a roll. The latest press replaces the others.
Input buffer: save a deflect. The latest press replaces the others.

Deflect: raise the sword, in one of two random poses, with K or right mouse, or from a saved press. Works at any time except during an attack, a deflect that has not blocked anything yet, a roll, a hit reaction, a grab, a posture break, or while a saved attack is waiting to play. DeflectCooldownNow sets the wait since the last deflect: short after a block, long after a miss. Also blocked during a deathblow and after death.
Hit reaction finished: back to the idle pose, which frees the player to act again.
Deflect finished: back to the idle pose, which frees the player to move and attack again.
This deflect blocked something: the next one is ready after the short DeflectCooldown, so clean deflects can chain.
This deflect blocked nothing, outside the ultimate: wait DeflectWhiffCooldown from now, and drop any saved deflect, so mashing leaves the player open.
This deflect blocked nothing, during the ultimate: only a brief DeflectUltWhiff wait, so a mistimed press costs a little without losing the rest of the slashes. A saved deflect is dropped too.
Start an attack, once AttackRecovery seconds have passed since the last one. Blocked while ControlsLocked is on, or during a deflect or hit reaction.
Saved press after Attack_One: play Attack_Two once Attack_One has finished, the pause is done, and any deflect, roll or hit reaction has ended.
Saved press after Attack_Two (or after a pause with no attack before it): start over with Attack_One once the pause is done and any deflect, roll or hit reaction has ended.
Pause over with nothing saved: the combo is finished, so the next press starts at Attack_One.
Player_Attack_One finished: go back to idle and start the AttackRecovery pause. ComboStep stays at 1 so a saved press can continue into Attack_Two.
Player_Attack_Two finished: go back to idle and start the AttackRecovery pause.

Lunge: Q spends LungeCost stamina. He raises the sword, leans back, then pushes off. IsAttacking blocks moving, rolling and deflecting, and he can be hit the whole time, which cancels it. Blocked while rooted.
Facing right: the sword is on the near side.
Facing left: the sword is on the far side, partly hidden by the body.
Lunge: the sword swing plays once on the push-off frame.
Lunge: travel forward from the push-off frame until LungeDistance is used up or the swing lands or is dodged.
Lunge: the blade can only hit on the push-off and lunge frames. Keep the hitbox on the blade for those.
Lunge: during the wind-up and recovery, keep the hitbox away so those frames cannot hit.
Lunge finished: back to idle and start the AttackRecovery pause.
Stamina and Roll rules
Roll, from a fresh press or a saved one. Blocked while ControlsLocked is on, during a deflect or hit reaction, or while a saved attack is waiting to play. Blocked while rooted.
Saved roll with nothing left to wait for, so it could not play, usually for lack of stamina: drop it.
Move left. Blocked while ControlsLocked is on, during a deflect or hit reaction, or while a saved attack is waiting to play. Blocked while rooted.
Move right. Blocked while ControlsLocked is on, during a deflect or hit reaction, or while a saved attack is waiting to play. Blocked while rooted.
Standing still: go to the idle pose, unless a deflect or hit reaction is playing or the controls are locked, as in a grab.
